maria_cs: Quick cutover check — HotWire target is Tue 10:00 AM PT. Can we get a status on network ACL/VPN peer, KMS key policy review, and audit log forwarding? Any blockers?
hotwire_ops: Network ACLs are applied from our side, still waiting on your VPN peer config. KMS policy is currently with our legal team — ETA end of day Mon. Audit forwarding needs the Splunk HEC endpoint + TLS cert from you.
liam_net: @hotwire_ops I'll post the VPN peer config in 15m. One Q: do you expect NAT for egress to Splunk HEC?
hotwire_ops: Yes, NAT needed. Outbound to 10.11.12.0/24 via our egress. Splunk HEC: https://logs.hotwire.svc:8088 — cert signed by internal CA.
devon_sec: @maria_cs quick security note on KMS: policy must forbid plaintext key export; prefer GrantOnly usage. Can you share the key policy snippet so I can review?
maria_cs: sending snippet, PTAL. Also FYI renewal score flagged — dropped to 38% because of tight cutover timeline; ops handoff risk if cutover slips. We should surface to AM.
maria_cs: snippet:
```
{
  "KeyUsage": "ENCRYPT_DECRYPT",
  "Policy": "GrantOnly",
  "AllowUseFrom": ["redwood-inference"]
}
```
devon_sec: Looks reasonable. Suggest adding a Condition to restrict Principal to the specific service account ARN to tighten scope. I'll draft the change.
ronald_sre: I'll update the runbook to include the NAT route + Splunk cert install steps. ETA ~2h.
maria_cs: @account_exec (cc) can you prep renewal outreach if we hit >24h delay? :warning:
deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance for infra-network on Tue 03:00-04:00 PT — may impact VPN handshake.
hotwire_ops: Thanks — we'll approve the VPN after seeing the peer config. Legal mentioned they can expedite KMS review if you accept our DPA clause.
maria_cs: Noted. Action items:
- @liam_net: deliver VPN peer + NAT config
- @devon_sec: finalize KMS policy with Principal condition
- @ronald_sre: add Splunk cert step to runbook
I'll escalate to AM if any delay >24h. :white_check_mark:
